theorems.name: Submission.iwl_sp_lipschitzPushforward_apply_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (V : Set (Eucl Q)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (S : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q), Differentiable ℝ f → IsLipschitzPushforward X f S → ∀ (ω : TestFormOn V n) (η : TestFormOn U n), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) n) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) → S ω = X η
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
